runbook: R-18 / R-19 (fresh independent oracle; blind to diff, plan, src/, tests/, scripts/, git history)

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
read: data/items.json (4005 Imperial Mandate, 8020 Abyssal Mask, 8010 Bloodletter's Curse)

sources_quoted.quote: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
sources_quoted.corroboration: riotDescription: 'Nearby enemy champions take 12% more <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage>.'
sources_quoted.reading: amp is +12%, from ALL sources (allies included), but TYPE-RESTRICTED to magic damage

sources_quoted.quote: {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
sources_quoted.reading: amp is +7%, from all sources and with NO damage-type restriction (applies to physical/magic/true alike)

sources_quoted.quote: Cursed targets receive 10% bonus true damage from all incoming pre-mitigation magic damage.
sources_quoted.corroboration: same ability node: "damageType": "TRUE_DAMAGE"; notes: 'The additional damage inherits tags from the source, and attaches proc damage to it.'
sources_quoted.reading: the curse packet is a TRUE-damage instance whose base is the PRE-mitigation magic damage (i.e. before resistances and before any damage-taken modifier)

sources_quoted.quote: Independent damage value modifiers distinct from resistances: percentage damage amplification, percentage damage reduction, and flat damage reduction; percent modifiers stack multiplicatively with each other and with resistance-based reduction.
sources_quoted.reading: amps compose multiplicatively on the damage instance; they are not folded into the pre-mitigation base

sources_quoted.quote: Damage type not reduced by resistances or almost all damage-reduction effects; ... and is affected by most damage amplifiers (except jungle-item/Smite/Ignite true damage).
sources_quoted.reading: a general (untyped) amp such as Mandate's Vulnerable DOES scale true damage; a magic-typed amp such as Unmake does not, because the packet is not magic damage

sources_quoted.quote: curse amplifier (P: +10% bonus true damage on magic - AMP pseudo-slot) ... All damage atoms modeled (Q/W/E/R + P curse amplification as true-damage AMP).
sources_quoted.reading: the calculator already models Cursed Touch as a TRUE-damage AMP pseudo-slot row, i.e. exactly the kind of event a magic-only item amp must not touch
mitigation is the only resistance-stage operator; damage-taken amps are separate multiplicative factors, so 'pre-mitigation' in the Cursed Touch text is the raw ability value

step_1_identify_the_delta.rounding_band: with 1-decimal display rounding the true ratio lies in [252.65/225.65, 252.75/225.55] = [1.11965, 1.12059]
step_1_identify_the_delta.only_named_constant_in_band: 1.12 (Abyssal Mask Unmake, +12% magic damage). 1.07 (Mandate Vulnerable) and 1.10 (Cursed Touch) are both far outside the band.
step_1_identify_the_delta.conclusion: the change is exactly one application of Abyssal Mask's 12% magic amp, removed from this event. Nothing else in the cached data (Bloodletter's Curse 7.5%/stack MR shred, Abyssal's 45 MR, Mandate's 7%, Cursed Touch's 10%) reproduces a clean 1.12 factor: e.g. a target-MR explanation would need (100+R_new)/(100+R_old)=1.12, which for Abyssal's 45 MR implies R=275, and Vile Decay stack-count differences move the ratio the wrong way or land off-band.

step_2_rule_from_sources.mandate_vulnerable: x1.07, no type restriction -> applies to physical, magic AND true packets
step_2_rule_from_sources.abyssal_unmake: x1.12, restricted to 'magic damage' -> applies to magic packets only
step_2_rule_from_sources.amumu_cursed_touch: packet_true = 0.10 x (pre-mitigation magic damage); the packet's own damage type is TRUE, and its base is read PRE-mitigation, i.e. before resistances and before any damage-taken modifier, so Unmake enters neither directly (wrong type) nor indirectly (not in the pre-mitigation base)
step_2_rule_from_sources.composition_for_a_magic_packet: damage = raw x 100/(100+MR_eff) x 1.07 x 1.12   (both amps)

hypothesis_A_event_is_the_true_damage_cu.new_value_implies: 225.6 / 1.07 = 210.84 = 10% of 2108.4 pre-mitigation magic damage - a coherent fight-total magic pool for a leveled Amumu-side roster fight (Q + W tick stream + E casts + R over a timed window), consistent with the audit's description of the curse as a single AMP pseudo-slot row rather than a per-hit packet
hypothesis_A_event_is_the_true_damage_cu.old_value_implies: the same row additionally multiplied by Abyssal's 1.12, which contradicts both the type restriction ('increased MAGIC damage') and the pre-mitigation reading of the Cursed Touch base

hypothesis_B_event_is_a_magic_packet.verdict_under_B: old correct - but this requires the fix to have deleted a legitimate, plainly-worded amp ('from all sources') from an ordinary magic event, which would move every magic event in the scenario rather than a single indexed leaf, and leaves the scenario name's third term ('curse') doing no work

step_3_reconcile_with_the_two_candidate_.selection: Hypothesis A. The scenario name enumerates exactly the three amp sources whose composition differs only on a non-magic packet - Imperial MANDATE (untyped 7%), ABYSSAL Mask (magic-only 12%) and the CURSE (Amumu Cursed Touch, true damage off a pre-mitigation magic base). The single discriminating fact such a scenario exists to pin is that Vulnerable scales the curse's true damage and Unmake does not. The observed delta is exactly one Unmake application on one event, in the direction of removing it.

step_4_result.formula: pair_damage = 0.10 x premit_magic x 1.07 = 210.84 x 1.07 = 225.6 (Vulnerable applies, Unmake does not - the packet is true damage and its base is pre-mitigation)
step_4_result.old_value_error: 252.7 = 225.6 x 1.12, i.e. Abyssal Mask's magic-only Unmake amp was applied to a non-magic (true) damage packet - a +12.0% overstatement of this leaf

residual_uncertainty: The scenario definition and the event ledger live in scripts/ and src/, which this runbook forbids reading, so the damage TYPE of events[21] was inferred, not read. The inference rests on (a) the exact 1.12 delta being uniquely Abyssal's magic-only amp, (b) the scenario name naming Mandate + Abyssal + curse, and (c) the cached Amumu text plus the repo's own audit modelling Cursed Touch as a true-damage AMP row.

If events[21] were in fact an ordinary MAGIC packet on a cursed target, the old value 252.7 would be the correct one, since Unmake is explicitly 'from all sources'. Confirming the event's damage type would settle it definitively.

The 1.07 factor inside 225.6 is inferred (225.6/1.07 = 210.84 is a clean 10%-of-2108.4 reading) but not independently pinned; nothing in the delta bears on whether Vulnerable was applied, and 'both_wrong' would only follow if the 7% were also misapplied, for which there is no evidence in the two values.
